target_contract.meaning: Intent-coverage rejection, not ICU parse/format failure or linguistic quality judgment.

input_limits: Only these exactly representable nonnegative integers passed as one positional c_double at argument0. No fractions, lexical trailing zeros, offsets, =n selectors, #, nesting, custom number formatting, ordinal, duplicate keyword or arbitrary pattern.
library_policy: Check requested/resolved paths and exact bytes before any CDLL. Load resolved uc/i18n paths only; hash all three checked files again after cleanup. Drift/unreadable identity fails closed. These three files are not asserted to authenticate all loaded dependencies or runtime data. No native handle addresses in logs.

abi.status: signed32 UErrorCode; status<=0 allows success, positive is failure

call_contract.version: One actual u_getVersion call per started valid child. Require returned [76,1,0,0] before open; preserve mismatch as failure, not authenticated provenance.
call_contract.open: Once after successful guards/version; fresh status0, explicit UTF-16 unit length, null-terminated backing array, exact ASCII locale. Record status, nonnull bool and bounded parse-context unit arrays. Nonnull alone is not success.
call_contract.format: Exactly six calls only after successful nonnull open; each status reset0, capacity64 UTF-16 units, input c_double from frozen list. Check status<=0 AND 0<=returned_length<64 before reading exactly returned_length units. Decode strictly and compare exact marker. Stop immediately on first unexpected failure/mismatch; do not run remaining inputs or configurations.
call_contract.close: Finally once for every nonnull handle returned by open, even if open status failed or later formatting failed. Record attempt and return; failed/crashed close prevents complete success. No close for null handle.
call_contract.error_name: Do not call u_errorName or any other native helper. Preserve numeric status; optional static labels must explicitly say source mapping, unknown numbers remain numbers.
call_contract.warning_policy: All negative warning statuses are retained per call and allowed only with otherwise valid output. Do not require/reproduce/erase old -127 warning or infer its resource cause.
call_contract.call_trace: Flush monotonically numbered attempt BEFORE every native function and returned AFTER. Include name/phase/config/input where applicable and scalar/bounded output facts; open logs only handle_nonnull, never numeric pointer. Void result null. Separate attempted/returned counts derive from trace, never declared constants. CDLL loads are separate load-attempt/return records, not these native-function totals.

environment.helper: Exact copy of reviewed isolation.py; fresh owned absolute nonsymlink temporary root per child, prepare and validate before spawn.
environment.limits: Five writable locations and explicit environment, not sandbox or complete dependency/data authentication.

parent.launch: Absolute current Python executable and frozen child path; argv only, no shell; own Linux session/group. One fresh child per config, serial.
parent.receipt: Exclusive fresh batch UUID and per-config child UUID directories; STARTED receipt before spawn with parent/child IDs, command, source/protocol/helper/library identities, UTC and monotonic times, explicit environment map. Separate terminal receipt and raw stdout/stderr for every attempted config. Never reuse old PASS.
parent.fail_closed: No success summary until all expected calls/outputs/source hashes are verified. First failed/incomplete config stops expansion; later configs explicitly not started. Preserve partial trace and failure receipt; no retry. -O rejected before child spawn with fresh failed receipt, zero native calls.
parent.timeout: Preserve partial output; bounded TERM then KILL for owned group, inspect group state even if leader exits, record sent/return/remaining facts. No guaranteed reaping or crash-safe close.
parent.source_before_after: Pin protocol and every executable Python source via a frozen manifest before native launch and reread after each config. Preserve changed/missing sources as identity failure.
parent.success_meaning: Only the finite formatting/marker contract. Expected intent rejection in ar_omit_few is separately reported and does not turn normal ICU fallback into parser failure.

archive_acceptance.static_consumer: Check exact invocation/config IDs, pinned sources/raw hashes, typed metadata/environment/ABI, original patterns/inputs and literal outputs, native trace/call counts, lifecycle and cleanup. No import of executable child main or CDLL. Archive consistency is not signed/authenticated execution.
archive_acceptance.independent_repeat: Not yet authorized; require separate explicit coordinator instruction.
archive_acceptance.stopping_point: This finite batch or first unexpected failure. No expansion, engine/Unity, rendered Arabic/RTL/fonts, real translation/LQA, plural coverage of all numbers/locales or general transformer claim.
